EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2966–2895 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), a distinct band at 1069 cm⁻¹ consistent with an S=O stretch of a sulfoxide, and multiple intense low-wavenumber bands in the 600–760 cm⁻¹ region (623, 654, 695, 732, 763) characteristic of C–S stretching and ring modes. Among the candidates, only 1 contains a sulfoxide; candidate 9 has S but no S=O and would not account for the 1069 cm⁻¹ band. Lack of C=N or carbonyl bands disfavors candidates with imine/amide functionalities. Hence the cyclic sulfoxide (1) best matches the observed Raman features.
